caseName: Baltimore Gas & Electric Co. v. Natural Resources Depense Council, Inc.
caseNameFull: Baltimore Gas & Electric Co. v. Natural Resources Depense Council, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Vermont Yankee Nuclear Power Corp. v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc., ante, p. 519. Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
